items.label: Capture the delivery operating model context.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, Evidence target, risks, and unknowns are identified before editing.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > agent-and-skill-design, owner repo-project-control, active role project-control-steward with planning-partner and documentation-authority-steward responsibilities, phase target phase-agent-and-skill-design-delivery-operating-model, checklist target checklist-agent-and-skill-design-delivery-operating-model, and evidence target focused Project Control guard plus full Project Control gate.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard for the delivery operating model.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Project Control test fails before the Delivery Operating Model document, records, and entrypoint references exist.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-delivery-operating-model.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because doc-flowdoc-delivery-operating-model was not linked from the project-control node and Project Control entrypoints did not reference docs/domains/flowdoc-delivery-operating-model.md.

items.label: Draft the Project Control delivery operating model.
items.evidenceTarget: The new Project Control document defines PLAN rooms, real WORK rooms, lane cards, Kickoff Packets, handoff rules, Contract Change Requests, and first delivery slice boundaries.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-delivery-operating-model.md records the long-term operating contract without using the first delivery slice as the whole FlowDoc definition.

items.label: Route future FlowDoc rooms to the delivery operating model.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control AGENTS.md, global Codex guidance, and the agent operating model point future rooms to the Delivery Operating Model before broad delivery work.
items.verificationNote: AGENTS.md, docs/domains/flowdoc-global-codex-guidance.md, and docs/domains/agent-and-skill-operating-model.md reference docs/domains/flowdoc-delivery-operating-model.md and the PLAN/WORK room model.

items.label: Record Project Control records for the delivery operating model.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the Document, Work context update, Phase, Checklist, and Project Control Node link without product truth promotion.
items.verificationNote: Registered doc-flowdoc-delivery-operating-model, phase-agent-and-skill-design-delivery-operating-model, checklist-agent-and-skill-design-delivery-operating-model, and the project-control node document link; product repositories and map truth were intentionally not changed.

items.label: Verify the focused guard and Project Control gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Delivery Operating Model guard, generation, data validation, and full Project Control gate pass before handoff.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: tests/flowdoc-delivery-operating-model.test.ts, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check pass after Project Control records are registered.
